visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young men are seated side-by-side on a gray couch in a minimalist indoor setting with a plain light-colored wall. The man on the left wears a cream t-shirt, the middle man has long wavy hair and a brown t-shirt with a silver necklace, and the man on the right wears a white v-neck t-shirt. They are positioned behind a light wood-colored table. (2) The camera cuts to an extreme close-up of a yellow branded plastic cup held by a hand. The cup features the Green Giant mascot—a muscular green figure wearing leaves—and Japanese/Chinese text. (3) The scene transitions back to the three men holding the same yellow cups and drinking through long straws. Their facial expressions shift from curiosity to surprise and delight. (4) Close-up shots show a metal spoon dipping into the cup, revealing sweet corn kernels mixed with a beige-colored milky liquid and ice cubes. (5) The men engage in an animated discussion, gesturing toward the cups and the camera. (6) A can of Green Giant brand sweet corn is placed on the table next to the cup for comparison. (7) Close-up shots juxtapose the cartoon character on the cup with the traditional character on the metal can. The men laugh and continue talking until the video ends.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Three young adult Asian males in casual summer attire: one in a cream t-shirt, one in a brown t-shirt with wavy long hair, and one in a white t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A simple indoor space with a plain light-gray wall, a gray sofa, and a wooden table. The lighting is bright and even.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo synth-pop music begins immediately. Multiple male voices speak in an energetic and inviting tone. A short, high-pitched 'Ding' SFX marks a transition. (2) Sounds of a plastic straw being inserted into a lid followed by high-arousal exclamations like 'Wow!'. The music rhythm remains steady. (3) Continuous rapid speech with varied pitch contours as the speakers describe flavors. SFX of liquid swirling and a percussive 'clack' of a spoon hitting a plastic cup. (4) Laughter and overlapping dialogue increase in volume and energy. A metallic 'thud' is heard as a can is placed on a hard surface. (5) The music continues until a quick fade-out at the very end, accompanied by a soft laugh.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Review -> Humorous Comparison.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to review and promote a collaboration beverage between '八曜' (Hachiyo Tea) and '綠巨人' (Green Giant), focusing on the unique flavor of corn-infused milk tea and the updated, youthful branding of the mascot.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of branded products, repeated verbal praise of the taste, and comparison with original branded ingredients.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high editing density and variety-show style text to maintain high engagement for a short-form social media audience.
